GBFRER Summon Drop Picker (GUI) - Changelog
===========================================

v2.0.0
------
- Major rewrite: fully independent, per-summon customization
- Wee Pincer III added as a selectable summon
- Full 11-bonus menu for every summon
- Every summon offers its full skill pool
- Sigilis skills locked to max level 15
- New picker engine
- Picks are saved

Source code: https://github.com/Evoyn/gbfer-summon-drop-picker
